stage_registry.reason_zh: 官方边界、控规、权属和调查资料尚未齐备，不能诚实生成阶段面。
stage_registry.reason_en: Official boundary, control-plan, tenure and survey inputs are incomplete; an honest stage polygon cannot be generated.

entry_gate.zh: 仅以 provisional 输入登记，明确不得将其当作法定红线、权属边界或现状测绘。
entry_gate.en: Register the intake only as provisional, explicitly excluding statutory redline, tenure-boundary and surveyed-existing-condition claims.

exit_or_rollback.zh: 官方资料齐备后重建基线并重裁相关图层；资料仍缺时维持 not_spatially_mapped，不升级为空间承诺。
exit_or_rollback.en: Rebuild the baseline and recut dependent layers when official inputs arrive; if they remain missing, keep this stage not_spatially_mapped and do not upgrade it to a spatial commitment.

stage_registry.reason_zh: 仅将可逆的轻层试验讨论范围登记为 provisional 空间要素；不代表获批边界或实施范围。
stage_registry.reason_en: Only the reversible light-layer pilot discussion area is registered as a provisional spatial feature; it is not an approved boundary or implementation extent.

entry_gate.zh: 官方边界、控规、权属与调查数据到位，并经人工核验授权可逆的小范围试验。
entry_gate.en: Official boundary, control-plan, tenure and survey data are available, and human review authorizes a reversible small-area pilot.

exit_or_rollback.zh: 按评价指标和人工决定扩展、修正或撤除试验；未达阈值、投诉或维护能力不足时停止，并恢复静态替代。
exit_or_rollback.en: Use measured indicators and human decision to expand, revise or remove the pilot; stop and restore the static fallback when thresholds are missed, complaints arise or maintenance capacity is insufficient.

stage_registry.reason_zh: 通行、建筑、交通、机电、文保和市政专业复核尚未完成，不能诚实生成阶段面。
stage_registry.reason_en: Access, building, transport, MEP, heritage and municipal professional reviews are incomplete; an honest stage polygon cannot be generated.

entry_gate.zh: 底层核验完成，且轻层试验有可复核记录；通行、建筑、交通、机电、文保和市政专业审查均获得人工确认。
entry_gate.en: Base verification is complete and the light-layer pilot has reviewable records; access, building, transport, MEP, heritage and municipal reviews receive human confirmation.

exit_or_rollback.zh: 专业审查通过后由人工决定是否进入持续治理；未通过则回退至轻层试验或停止，不以推定几何补齐阶段面。
exit_or_rollback.en: After professional review, human decision determines whether to enter continuing stewardship; otherwise roll back to the light-layer pilot or stop, without filling the stage with inferred geometry.

stage_registry.reason_zh: 治理节奏不是诚实的 polygon，且责任主体尚未获授权，不能生成阶段面。
stage_registry.reason_en: A governance cadence is not an honest polygon, and responsible parties have not been authorized; a stage polygon cannot be generated.

entry_gate.zh: 角色、维护、投诉、数据权利、人工替代和退出责任均经授权并可持续复核。
entry_gate.en: Roles, maintenance, complaints, data rights, human fallback and sunset responsibilities are authorized and subject to continuing review.

exit_or_rollback.zh: 按治理复核和 sunset 条件继续、缩减或退出；责任授权失效或维护不足时停止，并保留人工/静态替代。
exit_or_rollback.en: Continue, reduce or sunset according to governance review and sunset conditions; stop and retain a human/static fallback when authorization lapses or maintenance is insufficient.
